हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/YQQzdP
show.description: When a poor nanny enters the mansion of powerful CEO Rohit Rajvanshi, she has no idea that her past and present are about to collide. Little Atharav grows attached to her instantly, but with every passing day secrets, betrayals and hidden truths shake the Rajvanshi family. Can love lost be found again, and can a child become the bridge between two torn hearts?
